messages.content: Read only the requested local fields from the current supplied text. For each known field select the supplied span IDs that support its value. The host binds these IDs to exact source text; do not rewrite or quote the source. Citation fields use full literal citation strings in the headings; a legacy label-ID output sentence is only an encoding instruction. Respect the question scope and roles. Never use old-source values. Use status unknown with value null if the current material is insufficient. Do not answer the entire task unless a requested field itself is that native label.
